name: Old Town and Glavni Trg
tagline: The main square, the plague column and the town hall
description: Maribor's historic centre around Glavni trg with its plague column and Renaissance town hall, running down to the Drava. The streets are compact and largely pedestrianised, holding the shops, cafes and restaurants, with the cathedral and the castle museum a few minutes away.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the square, the cafes and the river on foot
pros: The main square and the old town entirely walkable
Five minutes down to the Drava
cons: The highest rents in the city
Quiet in the evening outside the festival

name: Lent
tagline: The riverside strip, with the world's oldest vine
description: The old riverside quarter below the centre, where the Old Vine House holds a grapevine planted over four hundred years ago that still produces, and where the Lent Festival takes over the embankment for two weeks each summer. Bars and restaurants line the water and the old defensive towers punctuate it.
bestFor: Stays wanting the riverside bars and the summer festival
pros: Riverside bars and restaurants on the water
The Old Vine House and the medieval towers
Lent Festival on the doorstep in summer

name: Tabor and the Southern Bank
tagline: Across the Drava, residential and better value
description: The districts on the southern bank across the old bridge, largely residential with local shops, schools and the sports park, and the Pohorje cable car station at the far end. Rents fall noticeably once you cross the river and the centre remains a ten-minute walk over the bridge.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting lower rents and the cable car close
pros: Pohorje cable car at the southern edge
Ten minutes across the bridge to the centre

name: Pohorje
tagline: Up the cable car, ski slopes and forest trails
description: The massif rising immediately south of the city, reached in a few minutes by cable car from the edge of town, holding the ski area, a downhill mountain bike course, hiking trails and peat bog lakes. Accommodation is hotels and mountain houses, cooler than the valley and quiet.
bestFor: Skiers and walkers who want the slopes at the door
pros: Ski area and trail network directly accessible
Cable car into the city in minutes
Cooler and cleaner air than the valley
cons: Dependent on the cable car timetable

name: Jeruzalem and the Wine Roads (45 km east)
tagline: The ridge vineyards east towards the Hungarian border
description: The wine country east of Maribor along the Jeruzalem and Ljutomer ridges, where the road follows the crest between vineyards with klopotec wind rattles turning in the vines. There are small guesthouses and cellar doors, and the landscape is among the prettiest in Slovenia.
bestFor: Stays wanting vineyards and quiet with the city within reach
pros: Ridge-top vineyard roads and cellar doors
cons: Forty-five kilometres from Maribor and a car is essential
Little to do beyond wine and walking
